why_it_moved.text: The test arm ran a longer snippet as well as the new ranker, so the lift cannot be credited to the ranker alone.

why_it_moved.text: Longer snippets could change clicks on their own, which would feed straight into Successful Search Rate.

would_change: Rerun with snippet_length equal in both arms, or confirm in the audit trail that the snippet change was intended and register it, and the existing numbers can be read.
A pre-exposure comparison and a daily series by days since first exposure would clear the two checks that could not run.
